all_scores.question: Quais são os modelos de linguagem decoder-only (i.e., GPT-like) voltados para português lançados até final de 2024? Exclua modelos encoder-only (i.e., BERT-like), e encoder-decoder (ex: T5-like). O modelo pode ser público (ex: open-weights na huggingface ou github) ou privado (ex: disponível via API apenas ou apenas descrito em relatório técnico, artigo cientifico, ou blog post). O modelo pode ser apenas um finetuning ou further pretraining de um outro modelo base ou pode ter sido treinado do zero.
all_scores.response:
Below is a **non-exhaustive but fairly comprehensive** list of **decoder-only (causal / GPT-like)** language models that were **released by the end of 2024** and are **Portuguese-specific** (trained primarily for Portuguese, or explicitly adapted to Portuguese with continued pretraining / instruction tuning). I exclude **encoder-only** (BERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa/ALBERT-like) and **encoder–decoder** (T5/BART-like) models.

I group them into (A) **Portuguese-first / Portuguese-specialized base or instruction models** and (B) **notable Portuguese chat/instruct fine-tunes** that were publicly released (often community releases).

---

## A) Portuguese-specialized decoder-only LMs (public reports and/or weights)

### 1) **Sabiá (Maritaca AI)** — PT-BR focused
A family of decoder-only LMs obtained by **continued pretraining** of strong base decoders on Portuguese data.

- **Sabiá (paper / family)** (2023) – continued pretraining of **LLaMA** and **GPT‑J** on Portuguese  
  Source: *Sabiá: Portuguese Large Language Models* (arXiv 2304.07880)  
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.07880  
  Notes: reports sizes including **Sabiá‑65B** (reported; not necessarily publicly released weights).

- **Sabiá‑7B** (weights on HF; research-only due to LLaMA‑1 license)  
  https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/sabia-7b  
  Notes: explicitly **auto-regressive**; based on **LLaMA‑1‑7B**, further trained on Portuguese.

- **Sabiá‑2** (2024; described in paper; offered via product/API; weights not generally open)  
  Source: *Sabiá‑2: A New Generation of Portuguese Large Language Models* (arXiv 2403.09887)  
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.09887

- **Sabiá‑3** (2024; technical report; product/API; weights not generally open)  
  Source: *Sabiá‑3 Technical Report* (arXiv 2410.12049)  
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.12049

**Why included:** all are decoder-only LLMs explicitly developed for Portuguese (Brazil-centric) and publicly documented; some are public weights (Sabiá‑7B) and some are private (Sabiá‑2/3).

---

### 2) **Gervásio PT\*** (PORTULAN / Univ. of Lisbon) — PT-PT and PT-BR variants
A family of **instruction-tuned decoder-only** Portuguese models, built by adapting LLaMA-family models.

- **Gervásio PT\*** (paper) (2024)  
  Source: *Advancing Generative AI for Portuguese with Open Decoder Gervásio PT\** (arXiv 2402.18766)  
  https://arxiv.org/html/2402.18766v2  
  Notes: explicitly a **decoder** model; built from **LLaMA 2 7B** as base in the paper.

- **Gervásio 7B PTPT** (HF; later deprecated but released in 2024)  
  https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-7b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder

- **Gervásio 8B PTPT** (HF; replacement for 7B; released 2024)  
  https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-8b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder

- (Also in the same family, PTBR equivalents exist on the PORTULAN org; the paper describes both PTPT and PTBR variants.)

**Why included:** it’s a clearly documented, explicitly **decoder-only** Portuguese effort, with **open distribution** and both Portuguese variants.

---

### 3) **Other Portuguese decoder-only models explicitly cited as existing (2023–2024)**
The Gervásio paper also enumerates several PT-BR decoder-only models present on Hugging Face at the time (often with limited documentation). These are not “Portuguese-from-scratch” foundation models, but they *are* decoder-only Portuguese releases:

From the related-work section of the Gervásio paper (names + HF links as cited there):
- **Boana**: `lrds-code/boana-7b-instruct` (PT-BR instruct)  
- **Cabra**: `nicolasdec/CabraMistral7b-0.2` (PT-BR)  
- **Cabrita**: e.g., `22h/open-cabrita3b` (PT-BR; 3B class)  
- **Canarim**: `dominguesm/canarim-7b` (PT-BR)

Source where these are explicitly listed together as Portuguese decoders (with the caveat about limited documentation):  
https://arxiv.org/html/2402.18766v2 (Section 2.1 “Decoders for Portuguese”)

**Why included:** they are explicitly identified in a technical report/paper as PT-BR decoder models available on HF (even if “community-grade”).

---

## B) Notable Portuguese fine-tunes (decoder-only, public weights; usually instruct/chat)

These are numerous and fragmented across Hugging Face. Rather than list every single community checkpoint, here are **representative, widely referenced families** that were clearly released by end of 2024 and are decoder-only:

### 4) **Alpaca-LoRA PT-BR (LLaMA-based)** (2023)
- **Alpaca-LoRA-PTBR-7B** (instruction tuning of LLaMA for PT-BR)  
  https://github.com/DominguesM/alpaca-lora-ptbr-7b  
**Why included:** early, influential PT-BR instruction-tune on a decoder-only base.

### 5) **Portuguese Mistral/LLaMA instruct fine-tunes (2023–2024)**
Examples (there are many similar):
- **Boto-7B** (Mistral 7B fine-tune for Portuguese)  
  https://huggingface.co/lucianosb/boto-7B  
- **OpenHermes/Mistral PT-BR variants** (community PT-BR fine-tunes)  
  Example: https://huggingface.co/BornSaint/OpenHermesV2-PTBR-portuguese-brazil-gguf  

### 6) **Llama 3 Portuguese fine-tunes (2024)**
After Meta Llama 3 release (2024), Portuguese instruction datasets were used for PT-BR fine-tunes, e.g.:
- `artificialguybr/llama3-8b-alpacadata-ptbr`  
  https://huggingface.co/artificialguybr/llama3-8b-alpacadata-ptbr  

**Why included:** still decoder-only and explicitly PT-BR fine-tuned releases (even if not “foundation” models).

---

## Important caveats / scope notes

1. **“For Portuguese” can mean different things.**  
   I interpreted it as models **explicitly trained/adapted for Portuguese** (PT-BR and/or PT-PT), not merely “multilingual models that happen to speak Portuguese” (e.g., GPT‑3/4, LLaMA base, Mistral base, BLOOM, etc.).

2. **There are hundreds of Portuguese HF fine-tunes** (often small deltas, GGUF conversions, or lightly trained checkpoints). Listing *all* of them isn’t practical without a strict criterion (e.g., minimum downloads, minimum parameter count, or “mentioned in a paper/benchmark/leaderboard”).

3. **Some “released by end of 2024” models have later updates** (newer checkpoints, deprecations). I counted them if there was a public model card / paper / report by 2024-12-31.

---

## If you want, I can tighten this into a “catalog” with clear inclusion rules
Tell me your preference and I’ll produce a clean table:

- **Variant(s):** PT-BR / PT-PT  
- **Type:** base (continued pretraining) vs instruct/chat fine-tune  
- **Access:** open weights vs API/private  
- **Base architecture:** LLaMA-1/2/3, GPT‑J, Mistral, etc.  
- **Release date evidence:** paper date / HF commit / arXiv submission date  

Also tell me whether you want to include **Portuguese GPT‑2 style models** (e.g., “gpt2-small-portuguese” and other older causal LMs), which are decoder-only but much smaller and pre-LLM-wave.

all_scores.question: Quais são os modelos de linguagem decoder-only (i.e., GPT-like) voltados para português lançados até final de 2024? Exclua modelos encoder-only (i.e., BERT-like), e encoder-decoder (ex: T5-like). O modelo pode ser público (ex: open-weights na huggingface ou github) ou privado (ex: disponível via API apenas ou apenas descrito em relatório técnico, artigo cientifico, ou blog post). O modelo pode ser apenas um finetuning ou further pretraining de um outro modelo base ou pode ter sido treinado do zero.
all_scores.response:
Below is a (best-effort) list of **decoder-only / causal (GPT-like) language models with a clear Portuguese focus** that were **released by the end of 2024**. I’m excluding **encoder-only** (BERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa) and **encoder–decoder** (T5) models.

I’m also separating **Portuguese-focused models** (trained from scratch or continued-pretrained / instruction-tuned primarily for Portuguese) from **general multilingual GPT-like models** that include Portuguese but were not released “for Portuguese” specifically.

---

## 1) Portuguese-focused decoder-only models (open weights or documented releases)

### GPorTuguese-2 (Portuguese GPT‑2 small)
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese-centric GPT‑2
- **Base:** GPT‑2 small (fine-tuned/adapted)
- **Release:** 2020
- **Where:** Hugging Face model card: https://huggingface.co/pierreguillou/gpt2-small-portuguese

### openCabrita 3B (and Cabrita family)
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese continued pretraining + tokenizer adaptation
- **Base:** OpenLLaMA 3B
- **Release / paper:** 2023 (arXiv Aug 2023)
- **Where:** HF weights https://huggingface.co/22h/open-cabrita3b  
  Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11878

### Sabiá (Maritaca AI) – Sabiá‑7B (open weights) + larger variants (reported/private)
- **Type:** decoder-only Portuguese LLM family (continued pretraining on Portuguese)
- **Base:** LLaMA‑1 7B for **Sabiá‑7B**; also continued-pretrained **GPT‑J** and larger LLaMA variants reported in the paper
- **Release:** paper 2023; **Sabiá‑7B weights available on HF** (research license)
- **Where:** HF https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/sabia-7b  
  Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.07880  
  (Paper describes Sabiá‑65B and Sabiá‑J variants; those were not generally released as open weights.)

### Canarim‑7B (+ Canarim‑7B‑Instruct)
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese continued pretraining and instruct tuning variants
- **Base:** LLaMA‑2 7B (continued pretrained on Portuguese CommonCrawl subset)
- **Release:** 2023 (HF citation year; instruct model updated Dec 2023)
- **Where:** HF base https://huggingface.co/dominguesm/canarim-7b  
  (Also: https://huggingface.co/dominguesm/Canarim-7B-Instruct )

### Bode (Portuguese prompt/instruction model; 7B & 13B described)
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese instruction/prompt fine-tune
- **Base:** LLaMA‑2 (fine-tuned; paper describes 7B and 13B)
- **Release / paper:** 2024
- **Where:** Paper page https://arxiv.org/html/2401.02909  
  (Example HF model: https://huggingface.co/recogna-nlp/bode-7b-alpaca-pt-br )

### Gervásio PT* (PORTULAN) – PT‑PT and PT‑BR decoders
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese instruction-tuned decoders
- **Base:** LLaMA‑2 7B as starting point (per paper)
- **Release / paper:** 2024
- **Where:** Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.18766  
  HF examples:  
  - PT‑PT 7B https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-7b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder  
  - PT‑BR 7B https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-7b-portuguese-ptbr-decoder  
  - PT‑PT 8B https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-8b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder  
  (A 70B PT‑PT decoder exists on HF but appears updated later than 2024.)

### GlórIA (European Portuguese)
- **Type:** decoder-only; PT‑PT focused generative LLM
- **Base:** GPT‑Neo 1.3B
- **Release / paper:** 2024 (Feb 2024)
- **Where:** Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.12969  
  HF weights https://huggingface.co/NOVA-vision-language/GlorIA-1.3B

### TeenyTinyLlama (TTL) (Brazilian Portuguese)
- **Type:** decoder-only; **trained from scratch** (small models) for PT‑BR text generation
- **Release / paper:** 2024
- **Where:** Paper (arXiv HTML) https://arxiv.org/html/2401.16640v1  
  (Models/collection linked in the paper; e.g. HF collections under nicholasKluge.)

### Tucano (Portuguese; natively pre-trained) + Instruct variants
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese-native pretraining at larger scale; instruct fine-tunes
- **Release:** arXiv preprint is 2024 (Nov 2024)
- **Where:** Project page https://nkluge-correa.github.io/Tucano/  
  arXiv https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.07854  
  HF org/models https://huggingface.co/TucanoBR

### Samba‑1.1B (Portuguese)
- **Type:** decoder-only; Portuguese-trained/fine-tuned chat model
- **Base:** TinyLlama‑1.1B‑Chat (LLaMA‑2 family)
- **Release:** 2024 (HF repo existed by 2024; cited in 2024 Portuguese LLM literature)
- **Where:** HF https://huggingface.co/lrds-code/samba-1.1B

### Carvalho_pt-gl‑1.3B (European Portuguese + Galician)
- **Type:** decoder-only causal LM for **Galician and European Portuguese**
- **Base:** continual pretraining of Cerebras‑GPT‑1.3B (via AINA intermediate)
- **Release:** 2024 (model card + associated 2024 publication)
- **Where:** HF https://huggingface.co/Nos-PT/Carvalho_pt-gl-1.3B

---

## 2) Private/API Portuguese LLM releases by end of 2024 (no open weights)

These are decoder-style LLMs offered via API / product, with public technical reporting.

### Maritaca AI: Sabiá‑2 / Sabiá‑3 (API family)
- **Type:** decoder-only (commercial LLM family for Portuguese; served via MariTalk API)
- **Release:** Sabiá‑2 launched 2024 (company communications); Sabiá‑3 technical report is 2024
- **Where:** API page https://www.maritaca.ai/api  
  MariTalk API repo (notes include OpenAI-compatible API and model names) https://github.com/maritaca-ai/maritalk-api  
  Sabiá‑3 technical report (2024) appears on arXiv: https://arxiv.org/html/2410.12049v3

### AMÁLIA (Portugal government-announced Portuguese LLM)
- **Type:** announced as a Portuguese LLM initiative (decoder-style implied in comms; details/weights not public by end of 2024)
- **Announced:** Nov 2024
- **Where:** Portuguese government note https://www.portugal.gov.pt/pt/gc24/comunicacao/noticia?i=modelo-de-linguagem-em-grande-escala-para-a-lingua-portuguesa  
  (Also summarized on Wikipedia: https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Am%C3%A1lia_(LLM) )

---

## 3) Multilingual decoder-only models (not Portuguese-specific, but Portuguese-capable) released by end of 2024

If you interpret your question as including *any* GPT-like model that can do Portuguese (even if not targeted at PT), then many qualify. Examples include:
- **mGPT (1.3B)** (multilingual GPT-3-like): https://huggingface.co/ai-forever/mGPT
- **BLOOM / BLOOMZ**, **XGLM**, etc. (multilingual causal LMs with Portuguese in training mix)
- **LLaMA 3.1** (explicitly lists Portuguese among supported languages; released Jul 2024): e.g. https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct

I didn’t expand this section into a full catalog because it becomes very large and diverges from “for Portuguese”.

---

## Notes / caveats
- Hugging Face contains **many** Portuguese “instruct” fine-tunes of LLaMA/Mistral/Falcon etc. without a clear “release” milestone beyond the repo date; I focused on models that are **widely cited / documented** (papers, notable project pages, or well-known HF releases).
- Some families have multiple checkpoints/sizes; I listed the most prominent public ones and/or the ones with strong documentation.

If you want, tell me whether you want the list restricted to **(A) models primarily trained for Portuguese** (monolingual/bilingual PT focus) or broadened to **(B) any decoder-only model with stated Portuguese support**, and I can produce a more exhaustive, dated table (name, org, base model, training approach, release date, license, links).

all_scores.question: Quais são os modelos de linguagem decoder-only (i.e., GPT-like) voltados para português lançados até final de 2024? Exclua modelos encoder-only (i.e., BERT-like), e encoder-decoder (ex: T5-like). O modelo pode ser público (ex: open-weights na huggingface ou github) ou privado (ex: disponível via API apenas ou apenas descrito em relatório técnico, artigo cientifico, ou blog post). O modelo pode ser apenas um finetuning ou further pretraining de um outro modelo base ou pode ter sido treinado do zero.
all_scores.response:
Below is a (non-exhaustive but fairly comprehensive) list of **decoder-only / autoregressive (GPT-like) language models targeting Portuguese** that were **released (publicly or via report/API availability) by 31 Dec 2024**. I **exclude encoder-only (BERT-like)** and **encoder–decoder (T5-like)** models.

I group them into (A) *Portuguese-first / Portuguese-specialized base models* and (B) *Portuguese-adapted instruction/assistant models and notable fine-tunes*. Many community fine-tunes exist; I list the ones that are clearly described/released and commonly referenced.

---

## A) Portuguese-first / Portuguese-specialized decoder-only base models

### 1) **Sabiá family (Maritaca AI)** — PT-BR focused (public + API + reports)
- **Sabiá-7B** (public weights)
  - Type: decoder-only (LLaMA-1-7B architecture), continued pretraining for Portuguese.
  - Release: model card + paper (2023; HF model remains available).
  - Link: https://huggingface.co/maritaca-ai/sabia-7b  
  - Paper: *Sabiá: Portuguese Large Language Models* https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.07880
- **Sabiá-65B** (reported in paper; typically not fully open-weight)
  - Type: decoder-only (based on LLaMA 65B) further pretrained on Portuguese.
  - Source: same paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.07880
- **Sabiá-2 (e.g., “Sabiá-2 Medium”)** (private via product/API; described in tech report)
  - Type: Portuguese LLM family trained for Portuguese exams/benchmarks.
  - Source: *Sabiá-2: A New Generation…* https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.09887
- **Sabiá-3 + Sabiazinho-3** (private via API/product; described in technical report; 2024)
  - Source: *Sabiá-3 Technical Report* https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.12049

### 2) **TeenyTinyLlama (Nicholas Kluge Corrêa et al.)** — PT-BR tiny open base models (public weights)
- **TeenyTinyLlama-160M** and **TeenyTinyLlama-460M**
  - Type: decoder-only causal LM trained *natively* for Brazilian Portuguese.
  - Source/paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.16640  
  - HF (160M): https://huggingface.co/nicholasKluge/TeenyTinyLlama-160m

### 3) **GlórIA (NOVA / NOVA LINCS et al.)** — PT-PT focused open base model (public weights)
- **GlórIA-1.3B** (and also a 2.7B variant is described in the paper/project)
  - Type: decoder-only GPT-Neo–style causal LM trained on a large PT-PT corpus.
  - Source/paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.12969  
  - HF: https://huggingface.co/NOVA-vision-language/GlorIA-1.3B  
  - Project/announcement page also exists (NOVA LINCS blog): https://nova-lincs.di.fct.unl.pt/gloria-the-new-portuguese-european-large-language-model/

### 4) **Gervásio PT\*** (PORTULAN CLARIN / Univ. Lisbon) — open Portuguese decoder line (public weights; 2024 paper)
- Paper: *Advancing Generative AI for Portuguese with Open Decoder Gervásio PT-\** (2024)  
  - PDF: https://aclanthology.org/2024.sigul-1.3.pdf
- Public models include at least:
  - **Gervásio 8B PTPT decoder** (open weights; instruction-tuned on Portuguese resources; integrated in Evaristo.ai)
    - HF: https://huggingface.co/PORTULAN/gervasio-8b-portuguese-ptpt-decoder  
  - (PORTULAN also hosts other “Gervásio” variants, including larger ones; their HF pages document release timing via commits/model cards.)

### 5) **GPorTuguese-2 (Portuguese GPT‑2 small)** — Portuguese GPT-2 adaptation (public weights; earlier but still relevant)
- **GPorTuguese-2 / gpt2-small-portuguese** (Pierre Guillou)
  - Type: decoder-only GPT‑2 small fine-tuned/adapted for Portuguese generation.
  - HF: https://huggingface.co/pierreguillou/gpt2-small-portuguese

### 6) **GPT2-BioPT** — domain Portuguese decoder LM (public weights)
- **pucpr/gpt2-bio-pt**
  - Type: decoder-only GPT‑2 biomedical Portuguese LM, trained starting from GPorTuguese-2.
  - HF: https://huggingface.co/pucpr/gpt2-bio-pt

---

## B) Portuguese decoder-only assistants / instruction models and notable PT fine-tunes (public weights)

These are generally **fine-tunes** (often instruction/SFT/LoRA) of LLaMA/OpenLLaMA/LLaMA‑2 etc., released with Portuguese targeting.

### 7) **Cabrita** — Portuguese LLaMA instruction-tuning + tokenizer adaptation (public code/models; 2023)
- Type: decoder-only; methodology + released checkpoints (continued pretraining / tokenizer adaptation + instruct tuning for Portuguese).
- GitHub: https://github.com/22-hours/cabrita  
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11878  
- HF example checkpoint: https://huggingface.co/22h/open-cabrita3b

### 8) **Bode (Recogna et al.)** — PT prompt-focused LLaMA‑2 fine-tunes (public; 2024)
- Type: decoder-only; LLaMA‑2-based Portuguese prompt/instruction model (7B and 13B in paper).
- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02909  
- Public weights are commonly distributed as GGUF/variants; e.g.:
  - HF (GGUF): https://huggingface.co/recogna-nlp/bode-7b-alpaca-pt-br-gguf

### 9) **Alpaca-LoRA-PTBR (DominguesM)** — Portuguese Alpaca-style instruct fine-tune (public; 2023)
- Type: decoder-only; LoRA instruction tuning of LLaMA for PT-BR.
- HF: https://huggingface.co/dominguesm/alpaca-lora-ptbr-7b  
- GitHub: https://github.com/DominguesM/alpaca-lora-ptbr-7b

### 10) **Other widely-shared PT instruction fine-tunes of LLaMA/Llama‑2/Llama‑3 (public; 2024 and earlier)**
By end of 2024, Hugging Face contained many PT fine-tunes; examples (non-exhaustive) include:
- **Portuguese fine-tunes of Llama 3 (8B etc.)** (various community repos; released 2024 after Llama 3)
  - Example: https://huggingface.co/artificialguybr/llama3-8b-alpacadata-ptbr  
  - (Many others exist; “Portuguese”/“pt-br” tags on HF.)
- **Portuguese LLaMA-2 chat/instruct variants** (various community repos; numerous by 2023–2024)
  - The “Open Portuguese LLM Leaderboard” space lists many of these community models and is a practical index:  
    https://huggingface.co/spaces/eduagarcia/open_pt_llm_leaderboard

---

## What I did *not* include (on purpose)
- **BERTimbau, BERTugues, Albertina (encoders)** → encoder-only, excluded.
- **PTT5 / mT5 / T5 Portuguese** → encoder–decoder, excluded.
- Generic multilingual decoder-only foundation models (GPT‑3/4, LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon, etc.) **unless** there is a specific Portuguese-adapted release/family or a Portuguese-specialized report/model.

---

## If you want, I can refine this into a table
If you tell me whether you want **(1) only “Portuguese-first” models** (trained-from-scratch or heavy continual pretraining on PT), or **(2) include all notable PT instruction fine-tunes**, I can produce a clean table with: **name, size, base architecture, PT variant (PT-BR/PT-PT), release date evidence, availability (weights/API), and primary reference link**.

- **Rellana’s Twinblades** (Light Greatsword)

- **Sword Lance** (Heavy Thrusting Sword)
- **Blades of Stone** (Sorcery)

- **Shadow Sunflower Blossom** (Colossal Weapon)
- **Land of Shadow** (Incantation)

- **Spear of the Impaler** (Great Spear)
- **Messmer’s Orb** (Incantation)

### 6) Romina, Saint of the Bud — *Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud*

- **Poleblade of the Bud** (Halberd)
- **Rotten Butterflies** (Incantation)

- **Putrescence Cleaver** (Greataxe)
- **Vortex of Putrescence** (Sorcery)

### 8) Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame — *Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame*

- **Greatsword of Damnation** (Greatsword)
- **Midra’s Flame of Frenzy** (Incantation)

- **Staff of the Great Beyond** (Glintstone Staff; can cast sorceries *and* incantations)
- **Gazing Finger** (Colossal Weapon)

- **Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)** (Colossal Sword)
- **Greatsword of Radahn (Light)** (Colossal Sword)
- **Light of Miquella** (Incantation)

all_scores.question: Você pode fazer um relatório sobre todos os chefes de lembrança de Elden Ring considerando apenas o DLC? Quero saber todas as recompensas que podem ser trocadas por cada lembrança.
all_scores.response:
Below is a DLC-only report of **every Remembrance boss in *Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree*** and **all items you can obtain by trading each Remembrance to Finger Reader Enia** at Roundtable Hold. (These are the “Remembrance rewards” options; you normally pick one per Remembrance unless you duplicate it.)

## Shadow of the Erdtree — Remembrance bosses & trade-in rewards (all)

### 1) Divine Beast Dancing Lion  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Dancing Lion  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Enraged Divine Beast** (Talisman)  
- **Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp** (Ash of War)

---

### 2) Rellana, Twin Moon Knight  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Rellana’s Twin Blades** (Weapon: Light Greatsword)  
- **Rellana’s Twin Moons** (Sorcery)

---

### 3) Commander Gaius  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Sword Lance** (Weapon: Heavy Thrusting Sword)  
- **Blades of Stone** (Sorcery)

---

### 4) Scadutree Avatar  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Shadow Sunflower Blossom** (Weapon: Colossal Weapon)  
- **Land of Shadow** (Incantation)

---

### 5) Messmer the Impaler  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Impaler  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Spear of the Impaler** (Weapon: Great Spear)  
- **Messmer’s Orb** (Incantation)

---

### 6) Romina, Saint of the Bud  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Poleblade of the Bud** (Weapon: Halberd)  
- **Rotten Butterflies** (Incantation)

---

### 7) Putrescent Knight  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of Putrescence  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Putrescence Cleaver** (Weapon: Greataxe)  
- **Vortex of Putrescence** (Sorcery)

---

### 8) Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Greatsword of Damnation** (Weapon: Greatsword)  
- **Midra’s Flame of Frenzy** (Incantation)

---

### 9) Metyr, Mother of Fingers  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Staff of the Great Beyond** (Weapon: Glintstone Staff / hybrid catalyst)  
- **Gazing Finger** (Weapon: Colossal Weapon)

---

### 10) Promised Consort Radahn (Radahn, Consort of Miquella)  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of a God and a Lord  
**Trade-in rewards:**
- **Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)** (Weapon: Colossal Sword)  
- **Greatsword of Radahn (Light)** (Weapon: Colossal Sword)  
- **Light of Miquella** (Incantation)

---

### Notes / scope clarification
- The DLC has **10 Remembrance bosses** (above).  
- You asked for “remembrance bosses” specifically, so I did **not** include non-Remembrance major bosses, nor “Heart of Bayle” (which functions similarly but is not a Remembrance trade-in at Enia).

**Sources:** Polygon’s DLC Remembrance reward list and Eurogamer’s Remembrance boss/reward list (both compiled from in-game exchanges with Enia).

all_scores.question: Você pode fazer um relatório sobre todos os chefes de lembrança de Elden Ring considerando apenas o DLC? Quero saber todas as recompensas que podem ser trocadas por cada lembrança.
all_scores.response:
Below is a complete DLC-only list of **Shadow of the Erdtree Remembrance bosses** and **everything you can trade their Remembrance for** (via **Finger Reader Enia** at Roundtable Hold). I’m **not** including base-game Remembrances.

## DLC Remembrance bosses (10) and trade-in rewards

### 1) Divine Beast Dancing Lion  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Dancing Lion  
**Trade rewards (choose 1 per Remembrance):**
- **Enraged Divine Beast** (Talisman) — raises potency of storms  
- **Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp** — grants Cold affinity + “Divine Beast Frost Stomp” skill

### 2) Rellana, Twin Moon Knight  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Rellana’s Twin Blades** (Light Greatsword)
- **Rellana’s Twin Moons** (Sorcery)

### 3) Messmer the Impaler  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Impaler  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Spear of the Impaler** (Great Spear)
- **Messmer’s Orb** (Incantation)

### 4) Putrescent Knight  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of Putrescence  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Putrescence Cleaver** (Greataxe)
- **Vortex of Putrescence** (Sorcery)

### 5) Scadutree Avatar  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Shadow Sunflower Blossom** (Colossal Weapon)
- **Land of Shadow** (Incantation)

### 6) Commander Gaius  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Sword Lance** (Heavy Thrusting Sword)
- **Blades of Stone** (Sorcery)

### 7) Romina, Saint of the Bud  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Poleblade of the Bud** (Halberd)
- **Rotten Butterflies** (Incantation)

### 8) Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Greatsword of Damnation** (Greatsword)
- **Midra’s Flame of Frenzy** (Incantation)

### 9) Metyr, the Mother of Fingers  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Staff of the Great Beyond** (Glintstone Staff; casts sorceries *and* incantations)
- **Gazing Finger** (Colossal Weapon)

### 10) Promised Consort Radahn (Radahn, Consort of Miquella)  
**Remembrance:** Remembrance of a God and a Lord  
**Trade rewards:**
- **Greatsword of Radahn (Lord)** (Colossal Sword)
- **Greatsword of Radahn (Light)** (Colossal Sword)
- **Light of Miquella** (Incantation)

---

## DLC note: Bayle “works like” a Remembrance, but isn’t one
This isn’t a Remembrance trade with Enia, but many players lump it in because it’s the same “pick one reward” idea:

**Boss:** Bayle the Dread  
**Key item:** **Heart of Bayle** (used at the **Grand Altar of Dragon Communion**)  
**Choose 1 reward:**
- **Bayle’s Flame Lightning** (Incantation)
- **Bayle’s Tyranny** (Incantation)

---

all_scores.response:
## Elden Ring: Nightreign — Nightlord bosses & first-time unique relic drops

Below is a complete report of the **Nightlord (end-of-run) bosses** in *Elden Ring: Nightreign*, along with the **unique relic you get for defeating each Nightlord for the first time** (these are the “Night of the …” relics tied to each Nightlord).

> Notes:
> - The expedition name (in parentheses) is the run/boss destination name shown in-game.
> - “First-time” here means **your first clear of that specific Nightlord**.

---

### 1) Gladius, Beast of Night *(Tricephalos)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Beast** (Green)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Stamina recovers with each successful attack +1  
- Starting armament deals fire damage  

Source: ComicBook relic list (Nightreign) — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 2) Adel, Baron of Night *(Gaping Jaw)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Baron** (Blue)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Improved Critical Hits +1  
- Art gauge fills moderately upon critical hit  
- Critical Hit boosts stamina recovery speed  

Source: ComicBook relic list — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 3) Gnoster, Wisdom of Night *(Sentient Pest)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Wise** (Yellow)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Increased maximum FP  
- Starting armament inflicts poison  
- Poison & Rot in vicinity increases attack power  

Source: ComicBook relic list — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 4) Maris, Fathom of Night *(Augur)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Fathom** (Red)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Increased maximum HP  
- Flask also heals allies  
- Items confer effects to all nearby allies  

Source: ComicBook relic list — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 5) Libra, Creature of Night *(Equilibrious Beast)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Demon** (Red)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Huge rune discount for shop purchases while on expedition  
- Gesture “Crossed Legs” builds up Madness  
- Madness continually recovers FP  

Source: ComicBook relic list — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 6) Fulghor, Champion of Night *(Darkdrift Knight)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Champion** (Green)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Increased maximum stamina  
- Guard counter gets a boost based on current HP  
- HP restoration upon thrusting counterattack  

Source: ComicBook relic list — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 7) Caligo, Miasma of the Night *(Fissure in the Fog)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Miasma** (Yellow)  
**Relic effects (as commonly listed):**
- Nearby Frostbite conceals self  
- Changes compatible armament’s skill to *Chilling Mist* at start of expedition  
- Attack power up when facing Frostbite-afflicted enemy  

Source: ComicBook relic list — https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/elden-ring-nightreign-boss-order-relic-rewards-explained/

---

### 8) Heolstor the Nightlord *(Night Aspect)*
**First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Lord** (Blue)  
**Relic effects (per FextraLife):**
- Switching weapons adds an affinity attack  
- Boosts attack power of added affinity attacks  
- Switching weapons boosts attack power  

Source: FextraLife (Night of the Lord) — https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night+of+the+Lord  
(Polygon also lists Heolstor as the Night Aspect expedition’s Nightlord) — https://www.polygon.com/elden-ring-nightreign-guides/603005/best-nightlords-order-boss-list-all/

---

If you want, I can expand this into a fuller “boss report” for each Nightlord (arena notes, major mechanics/status threats, and practical prep/weakness tips), but the above covers **all Nightlords + each one’s first-clear unique relic**.

## Elden Ring: Nightreign — Nightlord bosses & first-time unique relic drops

Nightlords are the “Day 3” expedition-ending bosses. Defeating each one **for the first time** awards a **unique Nightlord relic** (and in at least one case, an additional relic as well).

Below is a consolidated report of the Nightlords and the **unique relic(s) you get on first clear** of each.

---

## Base game Nightlords (8)

### 1) Gladius, Beast of Night (Expedition: **Tricephalos**)
- **What it is:** A three‑headed wolf that can split into three separate wolves mid-fight.
- **First-time unique relic drops:**
  - **Night of the Beast**
  - **Old Pocketwatch** (additional first-clear relic alongside Night of the Beast)

### 2) Maris, Fathom of Night (Expedition: **Augur**)
- **What it is:** “Augur” Nightlord (Maris), themed around the fathom/depths.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Fathom**

### 3) Caligo, Miasma of Night (Expedition: **Fissure in the Fog**)
- **What it is:** “Fissure in the Fog” Nightlord (Caligo), associated with mist/miasma.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Miasma**

### 4) Adel, Baron of Night (Expedition: **Gaping Jaw**)
- **What it is:** “Gaping Jaw” Nightlord (Adel), draconic/maw-themed.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Baron**

### 5) Gnoster, Wisdom of Night (Expedition: **Sentient Pest**)
- **What it is:** “Sentient Pest” Nightlord (Gnoster), insect/pest themed.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Wise**

### 6) Libra, Creature of Night (Expedition: **Equilibrious Beast**)
- **What it is:** “Equilibrious Beast” Nightlord (Libra), balance/equanimity themed.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Demon**

### 7) Fulghor, Champion of Nightglow (Expedition: **Darkdrift Knight**)
- **What it is:** “Darkdrift Knight” Nightlord (Fulghor), knight/champion themed.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Champion**

### 8) Heolstor the Nightlord / Night Aspect (Final boss expedition: **The Shape of Night**)
- **What it is:** The final Nightlord encountered after meeting its unlock requirements.
- **First-time unique relic drop:**
  - **Night of the Lord**

---

## Notes / scope clarifications
- The list above covers the **base-game Nightlords** plus the **final Nightlord** (Heolstor).
- Nightlords also have **Everdark Sovereign** versions; those don’t give the same “first Nightlord kill” relics listed above (they instead unlock “Dark Night of …” relics for purchase via the Collector Signboard after first defeating the Everdark variant).

---

## Sources used
- Eurogamer Nightreign boss list (Nightlords overview): https://www.eurogamer.net/all-elden-ring-nightreign-bosses  
- Fextralife Nightreign Wiki pages for first-time relic acquisition:
  - Gladius (includes first-clear relics): https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Gladius+Beast+of+Night

  - Night of the Demon: https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night+of+the+Demon  
  - Night of the Champion: https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night+of+the+Champion  
  - Night of the Lord: https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Night+of+the+Lord

all_scores.question: Você pode fazer um relatório sobre todos os chefes Nightlord de Elden Ring Nightreign? Também quero saber todas as relíquias únicas obtidas ao derrotar cada Nightlord pela primeira vez e qual é a principal fraqueza elemental de cada um.
all_scores.response:
## Elden Ring: Nightreign — Nightlord boss report (base 8 Nightlords)

Nightlords are the 8 “run-ending” bosses fought on Day 3 of an Expedition. Defeating each one **for the first time** awards a **unique Relic** you keep permanently (usable in later Expeditions). Elemental weaknesses below are the commonly-cited “best” damage types.

---

### 1) Gladius, Beast of Night *(Expedition: Tricephalos)*
- **Overview:** A three-headed wolf-beast (often described as a “three-dogs” encounter), highly susceptible to being controlled/stance-broken by sacred damage.
- **Main elemental weakness:** **Holy (Sacred)**.  
  Source: Rock Paper Shotgun weakness guide notes Gladius is “very weak to Holy damage.”  
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Beast**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife):  
    - *Stamina recovers with each successful attack +1*  
    - *Starting armament deals fire damage*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Beast” page.

---

### 2) Adel, Baron of Night *(Expedition: Gaping Jaw)*
- **Overview:** A massive jawed monster that pressures melee with big bite/charge patterns; status play is very valuable.
- **Main elemental/status weakness:** **Poison** (status).  
  Sources: EIP lists Adel’s “Effective: Poison”; RPS notes a special poison interaction in phase 1.
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Baron**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife):  
    - *Improved Critical Hits +1*  
    - *Art gauge fills moderately upon critical hit*  
    - *Critical Hit Boosts Stamina Recovery Speed*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Baron” page.

---

### 3) Gnoster, Wisdom of Night *(Expedition: Sentient Pest)*
- **Overview:** A “two-creature” boss (moth + scorpion); managing targets and exploiting their shared vulnerability is key.
- **Main elemental weakness:** **Fire (Flame)**.  
  Sources: EIP lists “Effective: Flame”; RPS notes both parts are very weak to Fire.
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Wise**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife page text):  
    - *Increased Maximum FP*  
    - *Starting armament inflicts poison*  
    - *Poison & Rot in Vicinity Increases Attack Power*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Wise” page.

---

### 4) Maris, Fathom of Night *(Expedition: Augur)*
- **Overview:** An “unknown drifting entity” style fight; punishes with sleep pressure and area denial while being resistant to many options.
- **Main elemental weakness:** **Lightning**.  
  Sources: EIP lists “Effective: Lightning”; RPS notes it’s “highly vulnerable to Lightning.”
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Fathom**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife):  
    - *Increased Maximum HP* (FextraLife notes this is a flat +100)  
    - *Flask Also Heals Allies*  
    - *Items confer effect to all nearby allies*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Fathom” page.

---

### 5) Libra, Creature of Night *(Expedition: Equilibrious Beast)*
- **Overview:** A fast, teleporting, “alchemical” caster-beast themed around balance; inflicts madness heavily.
- **Main elemental/status weakness:** **Madness** (unique among Nightlords); **Holy** is often the practical alternative.  
  Sources: EIP lists “Effective: Madness”; RPS notes Libra is uniquely weak to Madness, but Holy is a strong fallback.
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Demon**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife):  
    - *Huge rune discount (20%) for shop purchases while on expedition*  
    - *Gesture “Crossed Legs” Builds Up Madness*  
    - *Madness Continually Recovers FP*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Demon” page.

---

### 6) Fulghor, Champion of Nightglow *(Expedition: Darkdrift Knight)*
- **Overview:** A highly aggressive “centaur knight” with punishing charges and spear patterns; rewards well-timed staggers.
- **Main elemental weakness:** **Lightning**.  
  Sources: EIP lists “Effective: Lightning”; RPS highlights Lightning as best and notes he’s very resistant to Holy.
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Champion**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife):  
    - *Increased Maximum Stamina* (FextraLife notes +10 flat)  
    - *Guard counter is given a boost based on current HP*  
    - *HP Restoration upon Thrusting Counterattack*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Champion” page.

---

### 7) Caligo, Miasma of Night *(Expedition: Fissure in the Fog)*
- **Overview:** A fog-hidden prehistoric dragon strongly associated with cold/frost; big arena coverage and frostbite threats.
- **Main elemental weakness:** **Fire (Flame)**.  
  Sources: EIP lists “Effective: Flame”; RPS notes Caligo is “unsurprisingly weakest to Fire.”
- **Unique first-clear Relic:** **Night of the Miasma**  
  - Effects (per FextraLife):  
    - *Nearby Frostbite Conceals Self*  
    - *Changes compatible armament’s skill to Chilling Mist at start of expedition*  
    - *Attack power up when facing frostbite-afflicted enemy*  
  Source: FextraLife “Night of the Miasma” page.

---

### 8) Heolstor the Nightlord *(Expedition: Night Aspect)*
- **Overview:** Final Nightlord; multi-phase “origin of Night” encounter with severe punishment and limited status cheese.
- **Main elemental weakness:** **Holy (Sacred)** (also has notable phase-related interactions; RPS notes Lightning is also very strong in true form).  
  Sources: EIP lists “Effective: Sacred”; RPS states weakest to Holy in both phases.

all_scores.question: Você pode fazer um relatório sobre todos os chefes Nightlord de Elden Ring Nightreign? Também quero saber todas as relíquias únicas obtidas ao derrotar cada Nightlord pela primeira vez.
all_scores.response:
Below is a consolidated report on **all 8 Nightlord bosses** in **Elden Ring: Nightreign**, plus the **unique relics awarded for a first-time clear** of each Nightlord expedition (i.e., the “boss relics” you get the first time you defeat that Nightlord).

> Notes on sources/terminology  
> * “Nightlords” are the end-of-run Day 3 bosses tied to an expedition.  
> * For first-time clear relics, the Nightreign Wiki pages consistently list at least the **“Night of the …”** boss relic, and in some cases additional first-clear relic(s) (e.g., Gladius also grants **Old Pocketwatch**).  
> * This report focuses on **standard Nightlords** (not Everdark Sovereign variants).

---

## 1) Gladius, Beast of Night (Expedition: **Tricephalos**)
**Boss profile:** A three-headed wolf that fights with close-range swipes/bites and a chained sword that creates wide sweeps. At a health threshold it **splits into three wolves**, then later reforms with more fire-enhanced pressure.  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** Extremely weak to **Holy** damage.  

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Beast** (relic)
- **Old Pocketwatch** (relic)

(From: Gladius page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Gladius+Beast+of+Night

---

## 2) Gnoster, Wisdom of Night (Expedition: **Sentient Pest**)
**Boss profile:** A **two-entity** Nightlord (a flying moth caster + a scorpion/shears bruiser) sharing a **single HP bar**. Phase change mounts the moth onto the scorpion and adds more overlapping pressure (beams, charges, debuffs).  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** Fire is especially strong (commonly recommended vs the moth).

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Wise** (relic)

(From: Gnoster page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Gnoster+Wisdom+of+Night

---

## 3) Maris, Fathom of Night (Expedition: **Augur**)
**Boss profile:** A floating, aquatic/“dream-ocean” entity that controls space with waves, gusts, and summoned hazards (e.g., explosive jellyfish). Signature threat is a **large-area Sleep (“Hypnosis”)** channel that must be interrupted.  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** Highly vulnerable to **Lightning** damage.

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Fathom** (relic)

(From: Maris page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Maris+Fathom+of+Night

---

## 4) Adel, Baron of Night (Expedition: **Gaping Jaw**)
**Boss profile:** A huge, aggressive dragon-like Nightlord with lethal grabs/charges and, at ~50% HP, a shift into **Lightning-infused** attacks with AoE fissures and arena pressure.  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** **Poison** is highlighted as a key counter (slows/creates openings).

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Baron** (relic)

(From: Adel page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Adel+Baron+of+Night

---

## 5) Caligo, Miasma of Night (Expedition: **Fissure in the Fog**)
**Boss profile:** A frost dragon that uses **fog as a mechanic**—obscuring vision to set up deadly attacks (ice blast / falling ice field) and layering **Frostbite** pressure with large sweeping hitboxes and aerial sequences.  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** Strongly associated with being countered by **Fire** (also noted to cause a debuff/stun interaction).

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Miasma** (relic)

(From: Caligo page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Caligo+Miasma+of+Night

---

## 6) Libra, Creature of Night (Expedition: **Equilibrious Beast**)
**Boss profile:** A goat-headed humanoid Nightlord preceded by a **merchant “deal” interaction** (buff in exchange for a drawback) before the fight begins. In combat it mixes staff combos, Golden Order-like glyph spells, and heavy **Madness** pressure; it can “meditate” behind a barrier that players must disrupt by breaking sigils.  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** Notably vulnerable to **Madness** (if you can apply it), also described as weak to Holy/Fire/Slash.

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Demon** (relic)

(From: Libra page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Libra+Creature+of+Night

---

## 7) Fulghor, Champion of Nightglow (Expedition: **Darkdrift Knight**)
**Boss profile:** A centaur-like lancer with high mobility, large-range thrust/sweep punishes, and a dangerous second phase where a **Nightglow arm/claw** emerges and adds poison/AoE complexity. Has signature “Golden Lance” ground eruptions and other holy/light constructs.  
**Notable weakness (gameplay):** Repeatedly emphasized as very weak to **Lightning** (notably can disrupt the Golden Lance channel).

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Champion** (relic)

(From: Fulghor page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Fulghor+Champion+of+Nightglow

---

## 8) Heolstor the Nightlord (Expedition: **Night Aspect**)
**Boss profile:** Final Nightlord and “origin of the Night.” Multi-stage fight beginning as **The Shape of Night** (spectral knight), then revealing **Heolstor** with a fully-imbued greatsword kit. Extremely versatile: mixes multiple elemental damage types and can inflict several status effects; includes a major arena-covering ultimate-style move (“Night of the Lord”) with a randomly chosen infusion.  

**First-time defeat unique relics:**
- **Night of the Lord** (relic)
- **Primordial Nightlord’s Rune** (relic)

(From: Heolstor page on Nightreign Wiki)  
https://eldenringnightreign.wiki.fextralife.com/Heolstor+the+Nightlord

---

## Elden Ring: Nightreign — Nightlord bosses report (bosses, first-time unique relics, main weakness)

Nightreign has **8 Nightlords** (the Day 3 “final boss” of each Expedition). **Defeating each Nightlord for the first time** awards a **unique boss relic** (“Night of the …”) in addition to a **Trace of Night** (key item). Below are the **Nightlords**, their **main elemental/status weakness**, and the **unique relic** you get on a first clear.

> “Main weakness” below is the commonly cited “best” damage type/ailment for that Nightlord (as listed by major guides/charts). Some bosses have other workable options, but these are the primary ones.

---

### 1) Gladius, Beast of Night (Expedition: **Tricephalos**)
- **Main weakness:** **Holy**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Beast**
  - Key effects: *Stamina recovers with each successful attack +1*; *Starting armament deals fire damage*.

---

### 2) Adel, Baron of Night (Expedition: **Gaping Jaw**)
- **Main weakness:** **Poison**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Baron**
  - Key effects: *Improved Critical Hits +1*; *Art gauge fills moderately upon critical hit*; *Critical Hit boosts stamina recovery speed*.

---

### 3) Gnoster, Wisdom of Night (Expedition: **Sentient Pest**)
- **Main weakness:** **Fire**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Wise**
  - Key effects: *Increased Maximum FP*; *Starting armament inflicts poison*; *Poison & Rot in vicinity increases attack power*.

---

### 4) Maris, Fathom of Night (Expedition: **Augur**)
- **Main weakness:** **Lightning**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Fathom**
  - Key effects: *Increased Maximum HP (+100 flat)*; *Flask also heals allies*; *Items confer effect to all nearby allies*.

---

### 5) Libra, Creature of Night (Expedition: **Equilibrious Beast**)
- **Main weakness:** **Madness**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Demon**
  - Key effects: *Huge rune discount (20%) for shop purchases while on expedition*; *Gesture “Crossed Legs” builds up Madness*; *Madness continually recovers FP*.

---

### 6) Fulghor, Champion of Nightglow (Expedition: **Darkdrift Knight**)
- **Main weakness:** **Lightning**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Champion**
  - Key effects: *Increased Maximum Stamina (+10)*; *Guard counter boost based on current HP*; *HP restoration upon thrusting counterattack*.

---

### 7) Caligo, Miasma of Night (Expedition: **Fissure in the Fog**)
- **Main weakness:** **Fire**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Miasma**
  - Key effects: *Nearby Frostbite conceals self*; *Changes compatible armament’s skill to Chilling Mist at start of expedition*; *Attack power up when facing frostbite-afflicted enemy*.

---

### 8) Heolstor the Nightlord (Expedition: **Night Aspect**; boss phases include “Shape of Night”)
- **Main weakness:** **Holy**
- **First-time unique relic:** **Night of the Lord**
  - Key effects: *Switching weapons adds an Affinity attack*; *Boosts attack power of added Affinity attacks*; *Switching weapons boosts attack power*.

---

- Weakness lists / weakness explanations:  
  - IGN Nightlord weaknesses table (all 8): https://www.ign.com/wikis/elden-ring-nightreign/How_to_Defeat_Every_Night_Lord

## Elden Ring: Nightreign — Nightlord bosses report (boss list, first-clear unique relics, and elemental weakness)

|---|---|---|---|

  - Noted effects: **Stamina recovers with each successful attack +1**; **Starting armament deals fire damage**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 2) Adel, Baron of Night (Gaping Jaw)

  - Noted effects: **Improved Critical Hits +1**; **Art gauge fills moderately upon critical hit**; **Critical Hit boosts stamina recovery speed**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 3) Gnoster, Wisdom of Night (Sentient Pest)
- **Weakness:** **Fire (Flame)**  
- **First-clear unique relic:** **Night of the Wise**  
  - Noted effects: **Increased Maximum FP**; **Starting armament inflicts poison**; **Poison & Rot in vicinity increases attack power**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 4) Maris, Fathom of Night (Augur)
- **Weakness:** **Lightning**

  - Noted effects: **Increased Maximum HP (+100 flat)**; **Flask also heals allies**; **Items confer effect to all nearby allies**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 5) Libra, Creature of Night (Equilibrious Beast)
- **Weakness:** **Madness**  
- **First-clear unique relic:** **Night of the Demon**  
  - Noted effects: **Huge rune discount (20%) for shop purchases while on expedition**; **Gesture “Crossed Legs” builds up madness**; **Madness continually recovers FP**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 6) Fulghor, Champion of Nightglow (Darkdrift Knight)

- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 7) Caligo, Miasma of Night (Fissure in the Fog)
- **Weakness:** **Fire (Flame)**  
- **First-clear unique relic:** **Night of the Miasma**  
  - Noted effects: **Nearby Frostbite conceals self**; **Changes compatible armament’s skill to Chilling Mist at start of expedition**; **Attack power up when facing frostbite-afflicted enemy**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

### 8) Heolstor the Nightlord (Night Aspect; also referenced as “Shape of Night”)
- **Weakness:** **Holy (Sacred)**  
- **First-clear unique relic:** **Night of the Lord**  
  - Noted effects: **Switching weapons adds an Affinity attack**; **Boosts attack power of added Affinity attacks**; **Switching weapons boosts attack power**  
- Sources: IGN weakness table; FextraLife relic page.

- **Best Television Series – Musical or Comedy:** *Hacks*  
- **Best Limited Series, Anthology Series, or Motion Picture Made for Television:** *Baby Reindeer*  

- **Best Performance by a Male Actor in a Television Series – Drama:** Hiroyuki Sanada — *Shōgun*  
- **Best Performance by a Female Actor in a Television Series – Drama:** Anna Sawai — *Shōgun*  

- **Best Performance by a Male Actor in a Television Series – Musical or Comedy:** Jeremy Allen White — *The Bear*  
- **Best Performance by a Female Actor in a Television Series – Musical or Comedy:** Jean Smart — *Hacks*  

- **Best Performance by a Male Actor in a Limited Series, Anthology Series, or Motion Picture Made for Television:** Colin Farrell — *The Penguin*  
- **Best Performance by a Female Actor in a Limited Series, Anthology Series, or Motion Picture Made for Television:** Jodie Foster — *True Detective: Night Country*  

- **Best Performance by a Male Actor in a Supporting Role on Television:** Tadanobu Asano — *Shōgun*  
- **Best Performance by a Female Actor in a Supporting Role on Television:** Jessica Gunning — *Baby Reindeer*  

- **Best Performance in Stand-Up Comedy on Television:** Ali Wong — *Ali Wong: Single Lady*
